knowledge_point: Splitting a Rational Expression With Two Terms in the Numerator
problem: If $\frac{16a-8}{4}$ is written in the form $pa+q,$ what are the values of $p$ and $q?$
worked_solution:
Splitting the fraction into separate terms and then simplifying the fractions in the individual terms, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{16a-8}{4} & = \\ \frac{16a}{4}-\frac{8}{4} & = \\ \frac{16}{4}\cdot a-2 & = \\ 4a-2 & .\end{aligned}
$$

Writing the above in the form $pa+qb,$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{{(4)}_{⏟}}_{p}a+{{(-2)}_{⏟}}_{q}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $p=4$ and $q=-2.$
